A synthetic project page with thirteen sections of generic text.

## Overview of the project

The overview section explains what the example project does in a few generic sentences for testing.

## Getting the pieces together

The pieces of the example project fit together through a small set of well defined interfaces.

## Installation on a workstation

Installation on a workstation takes a single command and a restart of the shell session afterwards.

## Configuration of the instance

Configuration lives in one file per instance and every key has a documented default value.

## Running the first capture

The first capture of a page writes a raw snapshot, a text form and a report next to each other.

## Reading the report

The report names the converter that won, the lines that were lost and the repairs that were counted.

## Working with sites

A site capture starts from a reviewable plan and ends in a hashed bundle with one manifest file.

## Handling papers

Papers are fetched as full text for a pinned version and never from the abstract page alone.

## Handling videos

Videos are transcribed from captions in the language of the video before any machine fallback.

## Index regeneration

The index is regenerated from files and every hand edit is preserved before a row is replaced.

## Timeouts and owners

Every deadline has one owner and every child runs in a process group the owner can tear down.

## Where to go next

The next step after reading this page is the developer guide, which lists every command in detail.
